visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of an older woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a grey t-shirt, a red apron with a white pattern, and white gloves. She is standing at a food stall, using a metal strainer to fry tofu in a large wok filled with bubbling oil. The background shows a busy, cramped food stall environment with stainless steel counters and various cooking supplies under bright artificial lights. (2) A series of rapid close-up cuts showcase a plate of fried stinky tofu topped with a generous amount of pickled white cabbage, fresh green basil leaves, sliced white onions, and minced garlic. The tofu is golden-brown with a crispy exterior. (3) The camera pans to a person walking down a narrow outdoor alleyway at night, flanked by stalls with red lanterns and parked scooters. (4) Close-up shots show tofu pieces being lifted from the hot oil, then a chopstick breaks one piece to reveal a soft, porous white interior. (5) The stall owner is seen adding multiple scoops of minced garlic and chopped scallions to a plate of fried food. (6) A hand pours dark soy sauce and red chili sauce from plastic squeeze bottles onto the tofu and pickled cabbage. (7) A chopstick dips a piece of tofu into a small bowl of dark dipping sauce. (8) Close-ups feature other fried items including long beige fish cakes and dark, rectangular blood cakes, garnished with the same onion and garlic toppings. (9) The woman places two full plates on a bright red plastic table. (10) The final shot shows the front of the food stall with various signs, including one that reads '郭媽媽' (Guo Mama), and a menu board with photos of the dishes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 高雄這間臭豆腐. (2) [Subtitle]: 配料多到像蔬菜盤. (3) [Subtitle]: 老闆娘給料. (4) [Subtitle]: 真的不手軟. (5) [Subtitle]: 開三十多年了. (6) [Subtitle]: 很多在地人都吃過. (7) [Subtitle]: 臭豆腐炸得外酥裡嫩. (8) [Subtitle]: 咬下去有淡淡香氣. (9) [Subtitle]: 配料有洋蔥、青蔥、蒜頭、九層塔. (10) [Subtitle]: 可以全部都加. (11) [Subtitle]: 再搭配自製台式泡菜. (12) [Subtitle]: 酸甜爽脆特別解膩. (13) [Subtitle]: 淋上特製醬油和辣椒醬. (14) [Subtitle]: 鹹甜香辣超刷嘴. (15) [Subtitle]: 想吃多一點可以選綜合拼盤. (16) [Subtitle]: 臭豆腐、黑輪、米血一次滿足. (17) [Subtitle]: 黑輪酥中帶Q. (18) [Subtitle]: 米血口感很紮實. (19) [Subtitle]: 想吃的話建議早點出發. (20) [Subtitle]: 郭媽媽臭豆腐. 高雄市鼓山區臨海一路21-8號. 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (21) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
